# Copilot evaluation (generated by `scripts/eval_copilot.py`)

26 questions written from the corpus documents (gold = source page + key phrase) and 4 out-of-scope questions. Answer mode evaluated: **template** (extractive template fallback — no API key in the evaluation run).

## Retrieval (in-scope questions)

| Retriever | hit@1 | hit@3 | hit@5 | MRR@10 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| dense | 77% | 85% | 96% | 0.828 |
| bm25 | 85% | 96% | 100% | 0.913 |
| hybrid | 77% | 92% | 96% | 0.854 |
| hybrid+rerank | 100% | 100% | 100% | 1.000 |

## Answers

| Metric | Value |
|---|---|
| In-scope questions answered (not refused) | 100% |
| Out-of-scope questions refused | 100% |
| Gold key fact present in the cited passages | 100% |
| Gold key fact present in the answer text | 69% |
| Answers whose citation markers point to retrieved passages | 100% |
| Answer sentences supported by cited passages (≥80% content-word overlap) | 100% |

Refusal rule: refuse when the reranker's top logit < 0.0 (the cross-encoder's own 50% relevance point — not tuned on this set). Lowest in-scope top logit: 2.09; highest out-of-scope: -9.88. With only 4 out-of-scope questions, treat the refusal rate as indicative.
Production retriever = hybrid + rerank (bge-small-en-v1.5 dense + BM25, reciprocal rank fusion, ms-marco-MiniLM-L-6-v2 cross-encoder on the top 20).
